lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let k : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hc : Continuous k := Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hpos : 0 < k x₀ :=
    real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφs, hφc, hφd, hφn, hφx⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤)
      (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hpos))
  have hi := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hφd, hφc⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hi
  refine ((hφd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hφc.mul_right ?_ (x := x₀) ?_).ne' hi
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : φ x = 0
    · simp only [Pi.zero_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hx, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact mul_nonneg (hφn (Set.mem_range_self x)).1
        (hφs (subset_tsupport φ hx)).le
  · simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, hφx, one_mul] using hpos.ne'
